entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
segments:
And in that day thou shalt say; this chapter contains to the millennial song of the church. 
 
The final issue of all the sufferings and conflicts of God's church shall be universal victory over her enemies, and permanent tranquillity and peace; "for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of her."

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
segments: The wells of salvation; which God has opened for his people.
